set.body:
Current-main assessment 2026-09-12:
Retain P1 scientific identity. The exact UnknownDesignAxis(run)/CategoricalObservationSource/GeneralizationAxis failure is not a current-main reproduction: those APIs are absent. Identified-evidence implementations exist in local candidates 574db30 and 4f079da, with follow-up 81a0408; none is an ancestor of HEAD. They are recovery/review candidates, not adopted or newly qualified code.

Current public contract has a different limitation: SampleAxis carries a count only; FoldPlan.leaveOneBlockOut builds folds from positional integer block labels and FoldPlan.alignTo validates only equal sample counts. FoldedResponseContext likewise checks count. These values cannot themselves establish that a fold schedule came from the response's identified run grouping. This is a source-backed identity/provenance gap, not a claim that every current leave-one-block-out prediction is numerically wrong.

Refined first step: choose and record the actual consumer baseline, then reproduce its specific grouping/receipt gap through its public API. Do not patch an absent ScientificSpecification validator, use the sample-axis label as a run-axis substitute, or adopt an entire provider-migration branch merely to make this issue's names match.

Acceptance on the selected baseline: carry exact sample and grouping-column identity into validation design and its result/provenance; preserve the scientific meaning of held-out runs independently of label spelling or ordering. Cover same-size foreign/reordered grouping evidence, run-label renaming/reordering, full grouping membership and predictor train/test separation on JVM/JS. Preserve existing named failure boundaries and verify numerical schedule equivalence where applicable. A count match, successful compile or historical branch receipt does not establish current grouping correctness. No code change, numerical reproduction or candidate admission was performed in this assessment.

Original branch-specific report:

The public Mvpa.run path for leave-one-run-out validation rejects GeneralizationAxis(run, ...) with ScientificSpecificationError.UnknownDesignAxis(run) because CategoricalObservationSource exposes sample and neural axes but not the identified run grouping evidence. Existing executable tests use the sample axis name, which makes the schedule numerically correct while the plan receipt cannot state what it generalizes over. Design an identified grouping-column/source-axis representation; bind ValidationDesign to that exact evidence; prove run-label reorder/rename laws; migrate examples; and delete the sample-axis workaround. Do not weaken ScientificSpecification axis validation.
set.title: Bind predictive validation to identified sample and run-group evidence
